idea-plugin.name: Test-Only Method Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Reports production Java methods whose only remaining callers live in test source roots.

Unlike the built-in Unused declaration inspection with "reachable from tests" = unused, this reports test-only-used methods as their own category: test methods themselves are never flagged, and the global entry-point behaviour of Unused declaration is left untouched.

Framework entry points (Spring, JPA, Jackson, scheduled and listener methods) are excluded via the platform's own registered entry points, so the results are usable on real Spring Boot codebases.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • Reports production Java methods whose every caller lives in a test source root.
  • Excludes framework entry points, constructors, main, record accessors and methods overriding library declarations.
  • Confirms each finding against the index, so references from Spring XML, SpEL, properties files and javadoc suppress the report.
  • Editable list of annotations that mark a method as knowingly test-facing, seeded with @TestOnly and both @VisibleForTesting variants.

globalInspection.displayName: Method used only from test code
